screens.title: yak.finance — financial systems from Yak Software
screens.description: Financial systems from Yak Software: infrastructure where being wrong is unrecoverable. The work currently starts with two pieces — Molt Petit and the Ledger built on top of it.

jsonLd.name: Yak Software
jsonLd.description: Independent engineering and research company in Andorra, working on dictation, coding agents, consensus protocols and financial infrastructure.

screens.title: Molt Petit — a deliberately small BFT consensus protocol — Yak Software
screens.description: Molt Petit is a deliberately small BFT consensus protocol with recursive certificates, deterministic finality and light clients that never need to replay history — implemented in Rust, imported into Lean 4 and machine-checked. The consensus core of Ledger.

screens.title: Ledger — records that stay correct and private — Yak Software
screens.description: Company records that stay correct, and private, even when someone inside — human or AI — has access to every server. The Molt Petit consensus core is proven; the ledger layer above it is designed and not yet built.
